newsitem.title: USA: Clorox knows no reason for stock drop.
newsitem.headline: Clorox knows no reason for stock drop.

text.p: Clorox Co said Monday it knew of no reason for the drop in its stock price. Shares of the Oakland, Calif.-based company traded 3-1/8 lower to 101-1/8 in thin trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

"With the low liquidity we have in our shares it doesn't take much in the way of buy or sell to make the stock move one way or the other," Frederick Reicker, spokesman for the company said. By early afternoon a little over 186,000 shares of the company were traded on the NYSE.

Last week the home cleaning giant said it plans to acquire Armor All Products Corp in a deal valued at $400 million. The company said the move was aimed at establishing itself in the automotive cleaning products market.
